combined_objectives.name: Maximize any Monk base ability with printed damage

balance_reports.name: Monk base ability cycle including Meditate

character_analysis.analysis_note: Expected listed value counts printed damage only. Expected follow-up dice damage uses its exact average. Chi, Evasive, Cleanse, Knockdown, undefendable damage, incoming defense, card manipulation, and tactical board state receive no hidden value.
character_analysis.overall_note: Each final roll is assigned once to the highest-valued completed configured outcome, so outcome percentages are mutually exclusive and total 100% including Nothing.
character_analysis.reroll_note: Meditate remains a valid teacher target but contributes zero raw damage. No rerolls means the opening 5d6 roll only; one and two rerolls include that many keep/reroll decisions.
character_analysis.teacher_policy_description: The teacher first maximizes the chance of completing any configured base ability, including Meditate, then uses raw damage to break exact success ties.
character_analysis.value_policy_description: This policy maximizes expected raw damage on every decision. Chi, Evasive, Cleanse, and Knockdown currently add zero value.

abilities.name: Fist Strike
abilities.recommendation: Reliable raw-damage route and a strong neutral default.

abilities.name: Meditate
abilities.effect: Gain 5 Chi; gain Evasive or Cleanse
abilities.recommendation: A valid reliability target; its status effects currently contribute zero raw-damage value.

abilities.name: Combo Strike
abilities.effect: Deal 6 damage; follow-up die averages 7/6 additional damage
abilities.recommendation: Pursue from Fist-heavy rolls that already contain a Palm.

abilities.name: Tempest Rush
abilities.effect: Roll 3 dice; deal their total (10.5 average); Knockdown at 13+
abilities.recommendation: High raw value but a difficult one-face symbol target.

abilities.name: Fist of Harmony
abilities.recommendation: Flexible straight route; Chi currently adds no numeric value.

abilities.name: Lotus Strike
abilities.effect: Deal 5 undefendable damage; gain 5 Chi and increase its stack limit
abilities.recommendation: Lotus-heavy opportunistic target; utility receives no extra value yet.

abilities.name: Fist of Tranquility
abilities.effect: Deal 7 damage; gain Evasive and 3 Chi

abilities.name: Transcendence!
abilities.effect: Deal 10 damage; gain Evasive, Cleanse, and 6 Chi; inflict Knockdown
abilities.recommendation: Do not force from neutral; pursue from exceptional Lotus-heavy openings.

abilities.name: Zen Strike
abilities.recommendation: Reliable mixed-symbol upgrade route; Chi receives no extra value yet.

abilities.name: Way of the Lotus
abilities.effect: Deal 2 undefendable damage; gain Evasive and 2 Chi
abilities.source: Lotus Strike II / Way of the Lotus
abilities.recommendation: Easier Lotus pivot whose utility receives no extra value yet.

abilities.name: Way of the Monk
abilities.source: Fist of Tranquility II / Way of the Monk
abilities.recommendation: Flexible four-symbol route; Evasive currently adds no numeric value.
